title: Household Maintenance Routing
task_prompt:
## task_008: Downstream Candidate -- Household Maintenance Routing

Draft a concise, friendly neighbor note to Karen Taylor about scheduling the HVAC air filter replacement for this week. The message should focus exclusively on timing coordination. Exclude: invoice numbers, HOA voting details, costs, and home records.
answer:
Karen —

Hope you're doing well! I'm looking to get the HVAC air filter replaced this week and wanted to check in with you first to make sure the timing works on your end. Any day Monday through Friday works for me — just let me know what might be best, or if there's anything I should keep in mind.

Thanks!
Alice
